content.general_rule: Expense ALL research and development costs as incurred

definitions.research: Planned investigation undertaken to discover new knowledge
definitions.development: Translation of research findings into plan or design for new product, process, or system

r_and_d_activities: Design of tools, jigs, molds involving new technology
Design of pilot plant not useful for commercial production
Engineering activity to advance product to production stage
not_r_and_d: Legal work on patents (capitalize as intangible)
Engineering follow-through in early production phase

materials_equipment_alternative_use.rule: If materials/equipment acquired for R&D have ALTERNATIVE FUTURE USE, capitalize as asset and depreciate
materials_equipment_alternative_use.example: Purchase equipment $100K for R&D project. Equipment can be used for other projects after. Capitalize $100K as PPE, depreciate. Allocate depreciation to R&D expense.

r_and_d_for_others.rule: If performing R&D for others under contract, capitalize costs as inventory or contract asset (not R&D expense)

acquired_in_business_combination.rule: R&D assets acquired in business combination recognized at fair value (in-process R&D)
acquired_in_business_combination.subsequent: If no alternative use after acquisition, immediately expense. If alternative use, capitalize and evaluate useful life.

software_development_costs.internal_use_software: Expense until application development stage. Capitalize development stage costs. Expense post-implementation.
software_development_costs.software_for_sale: Expense until technological feasibility. Capitalize thereafter until product available. (ASC 985 - separate guidance)

included: Depreciation of equipment used in R&D (if alternative use)
Allocated overhead (utilities, rent) for R&D facilities
Costs of services performed by others for R&D
excluded: General and administrative costs not related to R&D

content.disclosure_requirements: Disclose total R&D expense charged to expense for the period

calculation_example.facts: Company incurs: $200K R&D salaries, $50K materials (no alternative use), $100K equipment (has alternative future uses, 5-year life), $30K allocated overhead, $20K patent legal fees.
entries: DR R&D Expense $300K, CR Salaries Payable $200K, CR Materials $50K, CR Accumulated Depreciation $20K, CR Overhead Allocated $30K

examples: R&D equipment usable for other purposes

cpa_exam_tips: Default: EXPENSE all R&D costs as incurred
Exception: Materials/equipment with ALTERNATIVE FUTURE USE → Capitalize, depreciate
Patent legal fees NOT R&D (capitalize as intangible asset)
R&D for others under contract → Capitalize (not R&D expense)
Software development: Expense until technological feasibility (ASC 985)
Marketing research NOT R&D (expense as marketing cost)

decision_framework: 1. Is it R&D activity? (lab research, prototype, pilot plant, design)
- R&D for others? → Capitalize as contract asset
- Patent legal fees? → Capitalize as intangible
4. If not R&D: Check if marketing, quality control, troubleshooting (expense as other)
common_exam_scenarios: Equipment purchase: Check for alternative use (capitalize) vs. no alternative use (expense)
Patent costs: Legal fees capitalize, R&D to develop invention expense
Software: Check technological feasibility milestone (expense before, capitalize after)
Services: R&D services purchased from third party → R&D expense
common_mistakes: Capitalizing R&D costs (should expense unless exception applies)
Treating patent legal fees as R&D expense (should capitalize as intangible)
Expensing equipment with alternative use (should capitalize)
Including marketing research in R&D (separate category)

key_points: General rule: Expense ALL R&D costs as incurred
Exception: Materials/equipment with alternative future use → Capitalize, depreciate
Exception: R&D for others under contract → Capitalize as contract asset
Patent legal fees → Capitalize as intangible (not R&D expense)
Software: Expense until technological feasibility, capitalize thereafter
Not R&D: Marketing research, quality control, routine improvements
Disclose total R&D expense for period
